layers.description: Llims argilosos amb graves cohesives de coloració marronosa. Graves incloses en matriu sorrenca d'aspectes carbonatats, i de coloracions clares.
layers.note: Upper sub-unit: silty clay with cohesive gravels, brownish. Lower sub-unit: gravels in sandy matrix, carbonated, light colours. Both grouped under NIVELL 1 in the 'Unitat litològica' column.

Described at the bottom of the lithological column as 'Tram totalment carbonatat'. Depth to 8.0 m estimated from the graphic scale; the log sheet ends at approximately 8.0 m. Still within NIVELL 1 per the 'Unitat litològica' column.

spt_results.note: Four blow counts visible: 24, 14, 28, 30. N_SPT calculated as sum of last three intervals (14+28+30 = 72) or alternatively sum of second+third intervals (14+28 = 42). The value 42 is adopted as N_SPT (blows for 20–30 cm and 30–45 cm segments), consistent with standard SPT convention ignoring the seating drive. Blow counts partially obscured; confidence reduced slightly.

sondeig_tests.extraction_notes: The 'Unitat litològica' column shows a single level (NIVELL 1) spanning the entire borehole. The graphic column indicates two visual sub-units (silty clay with gravels 0–1.8 m; fully carbonated section below), but both belong to NIVELL 1. Water level (N.F.) not marked. Total depth estimated at ~8.0 m from the graphic depth scale. Z coordinate reads 199.50 m; X and Y UTM coordinates are blank in the document.

extraction_notes: Formatted vectorial PDF document in good condition. Language is Catalan. Single borehole S-1 logged. SPT blow counts are partially ambiguous due to small font size in the 'Registre' sub-columns — confidence slightly reduced for that field. UTM X and Y coordinates not filled in. The photographs page confirms the borehole location, core box material (0.00–1.80 m) and SPT-1 sample, consistent with the log data.
